#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

bool vectorsEqual(const vector<long>& a, const vector<long>& b) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool vectorsDotProduct(const vector<long>& a, const vector<long>& b) {
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        sum += a[i] * b[i];
    }
    return sum > 0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int nPoints;
    cin >> nPoints;
    if (nPoints <= 11) {
        vector<vector<long>> pointsArray(nPoints, vector<long>(5));
        for (int i = 0; i < nPoints; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                cin >> pointsArray[i][j];
            }
        }
        vector<vector<vector<long>>> vectorsArray(nPoints, vector<vector<long>>(nPoints, vector<long>(5)));
        for (int i = 0; i < nPoints; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < nPoints; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
                    vectorsArray[i][j][k] = pointsArray[j][k] - pointsArray[i][k];
                }
            }
        }
        unordered_set<int> affectedIndices;
        for (int i = 0; i < nPoints; i++) {
            bool affected = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < nPoints; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < nPoints; k++) {
                    if (!vectorsEqual(vectorsArray[i][j], vectorsArray[i][k]) && vectorsDotProduct(vectorsArray[i][j], vectorsArray[i][k])) {
                        affectedIndices.insert(i + 1);
                        affected = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (affected) break;
            }
        }
        cout << nPoints - (int)affectedIndices.size() << "\n";
        for (int i = 1; i <= nPoints; i++) {
            if (affectedIndices.find(i) == affectedIndices.end()) {
                cout << i << "\n";
            }
        }
    } else {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
